verdict.rationale: Adyen documents refund issuance through the Terminal API and the Customer Area dashboard. It offers referenced refunds, which tie back to the original transaction, and unreferenced refunds, which return any amount to any card presented at the terminal. That covers the POS, dashboard and API channels. However, the evidence shows only the refund-type names, not how referenced refunds behave. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that referenced refunds support partial amounts and return funds to the original card, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the refund flows.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds back to the original card from the point of sale, dashboard, or API

citations.quote: The Adyen Terminal API lets you make payments, issue refunds, collect shopper information, and perform other shopper-terminal interactions using a payment terminal supplied by Adyen.
Unreferenced refunds let you return any amount to any card presented to the terminal.
You can also issue refunds from your Customer Area
We offer two refund types: Referenced refund... Unreferenced refund...
